input.summary: Replace mandatory JAMS arbitration (seat redacted) with exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, and conform the retained arbitration machinery.
input.comment: [Playbook] New York law already governs, but disputes go to JAMS arbitration in an undisclosed seat; our position requires the state and federal courts in New York County to have exclusive jurisdiction over the merits, with interim relief preserved under Section 15.6(j). We have therefore replaced the arbitration referral and removed the now-inoperative arbitration machinery and cross-references.

ops.newText: shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York, and each Party irrevocably submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of such courts, subject only to Section 15.6(j).

ops.oldText: The arbitrators are not empowered to award punitive or exemplary damages, and the Parties waive any right to recover any such damages.
ops.newText: The Parties waive any right to recover punitive or exemplary damages.
